name: Jones Carvey
source:
"Manson, Manson! What should we do today?"

Jones is a shy, 7ft giant who thinks much more with his golden heart than his brain. He and Manson attend group therapy together, and his room is just down the hallway. When stressed or excited, he rocks in his chair and hums.

[From [url=https://thugzilla.itch.io/object-ward]Itch.io[/url]]
